item.title: Beelzebub Raises $3.4 Million for Hacker-Trapping Platform
item.description: The company plans to expand its research team, open new offices in Rome and San Francisco, and acquire new clients. The post Beelzebub Raises $3.4 Million for Hacker-Trapping Platform appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: What’s Hiding in Your Mobile Apps? Lookout MSEC Aims to Find Out
item.description: The new Mobile Security Exposure Center creates SBOMs for enterprise mobile apps to uncover vulnerable components, dependencies and hidden risks. The post What’s Hiding in Your Mobile Apps? Lookout MSEC Aims to Find Out appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Hacked Public Wi-Fi Gateways Used to Harvest Corporate Credentials
item.description: A threat actor has been using the compromised appliances to target the Microsoft 365 accounts of traveling corporate employees. The post Hacked Public Wi-Fi Gateways Used to Harvest Corporate Credentials appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Optical Computing Reaches Commercialization Inflection Point: Lightelligence PACE 3 Photonic Chip With 256x256 Matrix, First Real-World Deployed Photonic Computing at WAIC 2026
item.description: Lightelligence demonstrates first real-world deployed photonic computing at WAIC with Tianshu Light Cube access control system, announces PACE 3 chip with 256x256 photonic matrix for low-latency inference.

item.title: Heguang Quantum Accelerates Photonic Quantum Computing Commercialization With Deterministic Error Correction Breakthrough and Distributed Architecture
item.description: Hangzhou-based Heguang Quantum completes seed round, achieves first deterministic photonic quantum error correction code generation, targets HQ10 quantum accelerator sales by 2027 for hybrid classical-quantum computing.

item.title: China Reusable Rocket Launch Costs Drop by Two-Thirds: CZ-10B Net Recovery Success Marks Reusable Rocket Era as Space Economy Reaches Trillion-Yuan Inflection Point
item.description: China first CZ-10B net-based rocket recovery opens reusable era with 60-70% cost reduction, as space economy paradigm shifts from disposable launches to reusable assets across commercial and government programs.

item.title: China Cleaning Robots Sweep 70% of Global Market on Technology Innovation, Not Low Prices: Roborock Ecovacs and Dreame Lead With Stair-Climbing and Robotic Arm Features
item.description: Chinese home cleaning robot makers now control 70% of global market led by Roborock (27% share), Ecovacs, and Dreame, with innovative features like stair-climbing and robotic arms replacing price-based competition.

item.title: Chinese Academy of Sciences ZhiJing Zing Social Intelligence Model Tackles AI Most Embarrassing Weakness: AI System That Understands Social Context, Emotions, and Unspoken Signals
item.description: CAS ICT releases ZhiJing social intelligence system including SoMBench evaluation benchmark and Zing model that surpasses GPT-5.5 on social cognition with FLARE self-evolving training and OPD distillation.
